subject: Draft PIP packet for review — evidence checklist & timeline
thread_content_summary: Manager requests HR and Legal review of a draft PIP packet focused on evidence collection and measurable checkpoints; HR and Legal provide redlines and safeguards; leadership sign-off requested before employee outreach.
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft PIP packet for review — evidence checklist & timeline

Hi Mina / Markus,

I'm preparing a PIP packet for an IC on my team (performance trend over last 6 months). Before I schedule the manager/HR/employee conversation, I'd like Legal and HR to sanity-check the packet and the timeline. Attached is the draft (PIP_Draft_NF_v1.docx) built off the company template (PIP_Template_v3.docx). Key asks: 

- Can you review the objective acceptance criteria (pages 2-3) and confirm they are measurable and defensible?
- Legal: any wording to avoid around "termination" or implied guarantees?
- HR: privacy and evidence collection guidance — is the proposed evidence log sufficient?
- Can we keep this internal until sign-off? I don't want to loop the employee until we have final language.

Proposed timeline: share final packet by Friday 9/10, manager/HR sync 9/13, formal meeting with employee on 9/14 if approved.

I've also linked a Drive folder with supporting tickets and notes: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcD-ExampleDriveLink

Thanks — Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Eng Manager, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachments: PIP_Draft_NF_v1.docx, PIP_Template_v3.docx
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft PIP packet for review — evidence checklist & timeline

Thanks Naomi — I reviewed the draft quickly and attached a redline (PIP_Draft_NF_v1-redline.docx) with inline comments. High-level notes:

- Evidence: Good start. Please ensure each objective has a clear metric or observable behavior. Where you reference "improve collaboration," add concrete examples (e.g., timely PR reviews: average lag <48h over 30 days).
- Checkpoints: Recommend 30/60/90 cadence with specific expected outcomes at each checkpoint and the owner for measuring.
- Support: Add a section listing coaching resources (buddy, training, stretch tasks) and a point of contact for reasonable accommodations.
- Confidentiality: We should mark this thread as HR-confidential. Until legal signs off, avoid attaching sourcecode snippets or internal PR diffs in the packet — summarize them in the Drive folder instead.

I can lead the manager/HR sync on Monday 9/13 at 10am if that works.

Best,
Mina
Senior People Partner, Redwood Inference

Attachments: PIP_Draft_NF_v1-redline.docx
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft PIP packet for review — evidence checklist & timeline

Quick legal flags — thanks for circulating. High-level:

1) Language: avoid definitive phrases like "will result in termination on X"; prefer conditional phrasing ("may result in further action up to and including termination").
2) Dates and signatures: keep a clear audit trail (who authored the packet, who reviewed it, and timestamps).
3) Local law: if the IC is in the EU, ensure we confirm local statutory notice obligations — I need to know location to confirm.
4) Reasonable accommodations: include a line that discussions about accommodations will be treated separately and won't be used as evidence of poor performance.

Please keep me looped once HR has the final version. Laura, adding you for FYI / leadership sign-off on the proposed timeline.

—Markus
General Counsel (interim)
Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>

Thanks both — appreciate the quick turnaround. A few follow-ups: 

- Markus: employee is US-based (SF), so no EU statutory complication here. I'll add the conditional phrasing you suggested.
- Mina: I'll convert the subjective items to measurable goals as suggested and link to the PR/issue summaries (not raw diffs).
- Laura: can you confirm availability for a 15–20 minute sign-off call tomorrow 9/8 at 9:30am PT? If that works I'll block it and circulate the updated packet by EOD 9/8.

Proposed updated timeline (if we all sign off): 
- 9/08 EOD: final packet ready for leadership sign-off
- 9/09 9:30am PT: leadership sign-off call
- 9/13 10:00am PT: manager/HR prep sync
- 9/14 (afternoon): first formal meeting with employee

I'll keep the Drive folder as the single source of truth: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcD-ExampleDriveLink

Thanks,
Naomi

All right to proceed with the timeline subject to the small edits Markus and Mina suggested — particularly the conditional termination language and the clarified 30/60/90 checkpoints.

A couple of operational asks before we go live:
- Keep the packet internal to this thread and Drive folder until it is delivered to the employee.
- HR to own the scheduling of the manager/HR prep sync and the employee meeting invites.
- Please include a short fallback escalation path in the packet (who to contact for grievances and a timeline for appeals).

Naomi — you have my sign-off to update and circulate the final packet. I'll join the 9/09 sign-off call if my calendar allows; otherwise Mina can escalate to me with any redline concerns.

Laura Bennett
VP, People Operations | Redwood Inference
